description: Displayed on the base; former registration F-THBI. Taken down for refurbishment and returned to its plinth after restoration. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually.
museum_name: Base Aérienne 125 Istres-Le Tubé Mirage IV
